intent: Improve precise, strong musical impacts and the overall automatic ride while preserving authored inputs, impact definitions, seeded geometry plans, normal lines, and the prior dashboard. Numerical gains alone are insufficient.

experiments.result: 24/24 baseline tracks and physics counts exactly reproduce s3-c.

experiments.hypothesis: Use the remainder of the pair-refinement allowance on measured-sensitive coordinate blocks instead of leaving it unused.
experiments.interpretation: Mixed generalization within the dev panel; better perturbed strength with more body dragging and worse authored strength. Extra local descent does not reliably improve the complete ride.

experiments.hypothesis: At the same nominal evaluation allowance, transfer up to 24 initial-proposal samples to continuation guidance, enabling a response step and spending leftover rounds on coordinates.
experiments.interpretation: Reducing proposal breadth to fund local continuation refinement hurt the strongest impacts; a fairer nominal allocation was not a better physical allocation.

experiments.hypothesis: Kinematic catch-incidence proposals may find stronger, cleaner hits than shallow inherited entry proposals. Same full allowance and guards.
experiments.interpretation: Sharper entry candidates did not deliver a convincing quality gain and increased dragging and awkward arrivals. Entry sharpness alone is insufficient.

experiments.hypothesis: The future-value predictor ignores requested constructions and has historical evaluation-song overlap. Recollect current compiler probes on disjoint source groups and compare geometry-conditioned prediction, same-data geometry-blind prediction, and deletion.

Replace strong-arrival absolute heading/total-speed priors with normal/tangential centre velocity in the sled frame. Unlike the previous extra pose penalty, replace the competing constraints rather than adding one.
experiments.interpretation: The posture guard improves substantially, but real impacts and speed tracking worsen. A lower guard count is not sufficient.

experiments.hypothesis: Rebase response corrections at the best finite-difference probe, keeping the Jacobian, allowance and actual acceptance checks.
experiments.interpretation: Mixed small changes; rebasing does not reliably improve complete rides. Pair-response tests pass.

experiments.hypothesis: Complete-track refinement may stall because changed geometry invalidates saved suffix controls. Compare fixed rebuilding with bounded local repair only on those failures, on the same four saved seed-101 tracks. Every replacement must improve the complete objective.
experiments.caveat: Four-case feasibility study with extra work, not a production-panel gain.
experiments.result: Initial local-only rescue had no valid anchor and could not explore. Corrected seeded rescue recovered 1,637/1,823 invalid intervals, but only one of four rides improved, by 0.000059 whole-objective loss, for about 1M extra frames each.

experiments.hypothesis: Reassess deletion of the old future model under current construction policies; comparator for disjoint replacements.
experiments.status: candidate for simplification, not yet selected
experiments.interpretation: Impact quality is broadly similar, but air error and body dragging rise. Await the disjoint model comparisons.

experiments.hypothesis: Preserve suffix shape by rigid translation instead of reconstructing its controls, then validate complete physical behavior.
experiments.result: 0 improvements in four saved rides; most candidates still fail downstream construction or survival. Preserving drawn geometry does not preserve the rider state.

experiments.hypothesis: Trade two-branch depth-two continuation for single-branch depth-three continuation at comparable tree work, retaining root diversity.
experiments.interpretation: The depth-for-branching trade worsens authored strength and air tracking, with mixed perturbed results.

experiments.hypothesis: Keep a curve’s segment count fixed at its nominal duration during duration refinement to remove one source of discontinuous response. Preserve explicit faceted styles.
experiments.baselineCheck: Shared geometry source affects the evaluator fingerprint; all 24 baseline tracks were explicitly remeasured and every measured result is exactly unchanged.
experiments.interpretation: No convincing complete-ride improvement; quiet strength bias and air error increase. The geometry-sharing identity was explicitly remeasured, with exact unchanged baseline measurements.

experiments.hypothesis: Use unused response-round samples for differences between viable controls with the same topology, giving joint directions derived from measured feasible geometry.
experiments.interpretation: Small mean loss gains coexist with weaker very strong impacts, more dragging on perturbations and greater authored burst excess. Not adopted.

experiments.hypothesis: Shrink the response trust radius when the response step itself fails, even if coordinate probes improved the candidate.
experiments.interpretation: Shrinking after failed joint steps does not improve the complete authored rides; quiet strength rises above request.

experiments.hypothesis: Prepare steeper downward arrivals before strong asks, keeping the existing speed target, upright constraint and actual continuation judge.
experiments.interpretation: Very strong hits improve, but body dragging rises by roughly 1.1–1.5 seconds per minute and older impact rulers worsen. This is a physical tradeoff, not an unqualified gain.

experiments.hypothesis: Retain the selected two-interval continuation during joint refinement and use the same leaf valuation.
experiments.interpretation: The first coherent-horizon trial weakens very strong hits and increases authored impact loss. Keep the underlying horizon mismatch under investigation rather than adopt this execution.

experiments.hypothesis: Retain four distinct, physically replayed scattered arrivals for continuation search instead of the first viable carrier reconstruction.
experiments.interpretation: Retaining physically replayed scattered alternatives improves mean impact loss on authored and perturbed development cases under v1/v2/v3, with mixed guard changes and roughly 0.17–0.25M more physics frames. Reserved confirmation running; not yet promoted.

experiments.hypothesis: Characterize local catch capacity from exact saved prefixes at larger local allowance.
experiments.result: All 179 strong-request saved impacts reproduce exactly across four seed-101 rides. Extra local search improves mean strength bias by 0.007–0.015 per song, before testing any continuation. Two scattered searches lose a previously verified valid construction; these are independently reproduced and investigated in Q19.
experiments.caveat: Extra work and fixed-prefix local outcomes, not improved complete tracks.

experiments.hypothesis: Broader one-interval physical screening followed by deeper continuation of promising roots, at comparable approximate tree work and unchanged total allowance.
Keep already validated scattered candidates from the exact prefix/objective memo while reconstructing new carriers.
experiments.reproduction: Q17 loses Tiki section 59 and Luna section 42. This version retains both at exactly their prior measured impacts, 0.494 and 0.708 (rounded).

experiments.hypothesis: Resolve the current search profile before loading its construction policies, avoiding loading and replacing the V6 archive during V3 production.
experiments.interpretation: One coherent configuration path loads the selected archive once. All tracks, physics counts and judge results are exactly unchanged. Cold-process heap observation is not a whole-compile speed claim.

limitations: Four songs only; confirmation seeds do not establish unseen-music generalization.
Physical posture and body-drag diagnostics are guards and observations, not newly validated aesthetic objectives.
Compile-time differences during concurrent research jobs are confounded by machine load; physics-frame accounting is the work comparison until isolated timing checks.

diagnostics.caveat: Descriptive association across the 24-case development panel; target mix and arrival posture differ, so this does not establish a cause.

responseStudy.interpretation: Most local improvement comes from actual coordinate probes. This motivates a better use of their measured progress, not the claim that joint steps have no value.
